## System Architecture

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    subgraph Input[Enterprise Agent Task]
        A[Complex Task Definition]
        B[Agent Execution Trace]
    end
    subgraph Decomposition[Task Decomposition Engine]
        C[Task Graph Builder]
        D[Subtask Classifier]
    end
    subgraph Deterministic[Deterministic Evaluation]
        E[API Call Validator]
        F[Code Execution Checker]
        G[Tool Usage Verifier]
    end
    subgraph Subjective[Subjective Evaluation]
        H[Human Evaluator Pool]
        I[Calibrated LLM Judge]
    end
    subgraph Scoring[Score Aggregation]
        J[Result Normalizer]
        K[Unified Confidence Score]
        L[Structured Feedback Report]
    end
    A --> C
    B --> C
    C --> D
    D -->|Verifiable| E
    D -->|Verifiable| F
    D -->|Verifiable| G
    D -->|Unverifiable| H
    D -->|Unverifiable| I
    E --> J
    F --> J
    G --> J
    H --> J
    I --> J
    J --> K
    K --> L
```

## Sequence Diagram

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant O as Orchestrator
    participant D as Decomposer
    participant C as Classifier
    participant AV as Auto Validator
    participant HE as Human / LLM Judge
    participant S as Score Aggregator
    O->>D: Submit task + agent trace
    D->>D: Build evaluation graph
    D->>C: Emit subtask list
    C->>AV: Route deterministic subtasks
    C->>HE: Route subjective subtasks
    AV->>S: Pass/fail + evidence
    HE->>S: Rating + rationale
    S->>S: Normalize heterogeneous results
    S->>O: Unified confidence score
    S->>O: Structured feedback for retraining
```

## Evaluation Graph Decomposition

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    subgraph Objective[Enterprise Objective]
        T[Generate quarterly report]
    end
    subgraph Subtasks[Evaluation Graph]
        S1[Fetch sales data via API]
        S2[Execute aggregation query]
        S3[Render chart with tool]
        S4[Write executive summary]
        S5[Assess business reasoning]
    end
    subgraph Tags[Classification]
        V[Verifiable]
        U[Unverifiable]
    end
    T --> S1
    T --> S2
    T --> S3
    T --> S4
    T --> S5
    S1 --- V
    S2 --- V
    S3 --- V
    S4 --- U
    S5 --- U
```

## Confidence Score Aggregation

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    subgraph Sources[Evaluation Results]
        D1[Deterministic: 3 pass, 0 fail]
        D2[Human Rating: 4.2 / 5]
        D3[LLM Judge Rating: 3.8 / 5]
    end
    subgraph Normalize[Normalization Layer]
        N1[Binary to 0-1 scale]
        N2[Likert to 0-1 scale]
        N3[LLM score to 0-1 scale]
    end
    subgraph Aggregate[Aggregation]
        W[Weighted Combination]
        CS[Unified Confidence Score]
    end
    subgraph Output[Outputs]
        FB[Structured Feedback]
        OPT[Optimization Targets]
    end
    D1 --> N1
    D2 --> N2
    D3 --> N3
    N1 --> W
    N2 --> W
    N3 --> W
    W --> CS
    CS --> FB
    CS --> OPT
```

They break many renderers and image export. - Use shorter labels, multiple nodes, or subgraphs instead of forcing line breaks inside one label. INVENTION: --- invention-id: invention-20260716-153054 company: RedHat created: 2026-07-16T15:30:56 --- # Invention Idea We propose a hybrid evaluation framework that automatically decomposes complex enterprise agent tasks into verifiable and unverifiable subtasks, allowing each portion of the workload to be assessed using the most appropriate evaluation mechanism. Deterministic subtasks, such as API calls, code execution, or tool usage, are validated automatically, while subjective subtasks, including report quality or business reasoning, are routed through human evaluators or calibrated LLM judges. The framework combines these heterogeneous evaluation results into a unified confidence score that accurately reflects overall agent performance and provides structured feedback for future optimization or training. By transforming loosely defined enterprise objectives into measurable evaluation graphs, the invention enables scalable and repeatable assessment of AI agents operating in real-world business environments. OUTPUT: ## System Architecture `mermaid flowchart TD subgraph Input[Data Sources] A[Source A] B[Source B] end subgraph Process[Processing] C[Tracker] D[Detector] end subgraph Output[Results] E[Clean Data] F[Alerts] end A --> C B --> C C --> D D --> E D --> F ` ## Sequence Diagram `mermaid sequenceDiagram participant S as Source participant T as Tracker participant D as Detector participant Sys as System S->>T: Submit Data T->>D: Validate D->>Sys: Forward or Block ` Create diagrams specific to THIS invention.
